column1: # WinRT's Symbol (Windows.UI.Xaml.Controls.Symbol in the 8.1 Windows.winmd, 193 values, read with
# `tools/winrt-api enum Symbol`) beside the Lucide icon an app uses in its place, or "none".
# Our own data: a Lucide icon is listed when it means what the Symbol's name says. Its drawing is
# Lucide's own, never the Segoe UI Symbol glyph's (ADR 0001, 3). "none" where the meaning rests on a
# detail Lucide has no icon for (an overlay such as BCC or a calendar's reply arrow), or on a fill,
# since Lucide draws strokes only (SolidStar, MailFilled). Several Symbols may share an icon.
# One Symbol per line, in the .winmd's order, then a tab, then the Lucide name. LucideIconTests
# holds every name here to the generated set, so a Lucide bump that renames or drops one fails.
